mapper.select: SELECT tp.plan_id plan_id, tp.plan_day plan_day, tp.plan_seq plan_seq, ti.info_id info_id, ti.info_name info_name, ti.trip_place trip_place, ti.start_date start_date, ti.end_date end_date, a.attr_id attr_id, a.attr_name attr_name, a.attr_lat attr_lat, a.attr_lon attr_lon FROM travel_plan tp JOIN travel_info ti ON tp.info_id = ti.info_id JOIN attr a ON tp.attr_id = a.attr_id WHERE tp.info_id = #{infoId} ORDER BY tp.plan_day, tp.plan_seq
